content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I prepared a [product_name] V8.1 program and added an SF011 message text. The setup includes three parameters: a counter for the threshold, and an on-delay timer. I can adjust the counter's threshold value on the [product_name] operator device, but I'm unable to change the on-delay timer value. Any suggestions on what might be causing this issue are appreciated.

Unfortunately, I cannot fully resolve your issue because I do not have the FS04 version. I changed the hardware from [product_name] 8.FS04 to [article_no] Standard and transferred the program to my [product_name] with an operator device. I am able to modify both the counter and timer values without issues using the operator device.

Hello [user_name], sorry for the incomplete explanation earlier. I can change the value on the operator device, but it does not update in the [product_name] controller. I do see the new data on the operator device, but after some time, it reverts to the old value. The simulation works well, but when checking online after changing values on the operator device, the controller does not reflect the change. Also, attempting to change the value via the parameter change page on the operator device does not work.

With my [article_no] Standard hardware and your program, I cannot replicate this issue. Changing the timer and counter values using the operator device results in the values being updated in the [product_name] controller as well, which I can observe online. Even after downloading the program back from the controller, the parameters remain changed.
In your situation, I suggest submitting a support request. It might be a bug specific to the new FS04 version.
A new question from Periphery has been split into a separate thread, titled "Can't set value on Operator Device for On-Delay Timer." Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience an issue where changing parameter values using a [product_name] operator device updates the display, but the actual values in the controller do not synchronize immediately or properly. Some users report successful live changes, pointing to potential differences in hardware versions or firmware as contributing factors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that real-time parameter adjustments made on the operator device will instantly synchronize with and update the corresponding values in the [product_name] controller, allowing for live operational changes.
